message.content: Let me look at the build script and the work directory to understand how to build and test:

content:
Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/build.sh:
     1	mkdir -p $WORK/boringssl
     2	cd $WORK/boringssl
     3	CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -DBORINGSSL_UNSAFE_FUZZER_MODE"
     4	CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS -DBORINGSSL_UNSAFE_FUZZER_MODE"
     5	CMAKE_DEFINES="-DBORINGSSL_ALLOW_CXX_RUNTIME=1"
     6	if [[ $CFLAGS = *sanitize=memory* ]]
     7	then
     8	  CMAKE_DEFINES+=" -DOPENSSL_NO_ASM=1"
     9	fi
    10	cmake -GNinja -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=$CC -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=$CXX       -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="$CFLAGS" -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="$CXXFLAGS"       $CMAKE_DEFINES $SRC/boringssl/
    11	ninja
    12	fuzzerFiles=$(find $SRC/boringssl/fuzz/ -name "*.cc")
    13	find . -name "*.a"
    14	for F in $fuzzerFiles; do
    15	  fuzzerName=$(basename $F .cc)
    16	  echo "Building fuzzer $fuzzerName"
    17	  $CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11       -o $OUT/${fuzzerName} -lFuzzingEngine $F       -I $SRC/boringssl/include ./ssl/libssl.a  ./crypto/libcrypto.a
    18	  if [ -d "$SRC/boringssl/fuzz/${fuzzerName}_corpus" ]; then
    19	    zip -j $OUT/${fuzzerName}_seed_corpus.zip $SRC/boringssl/fuzz/${fuzzerName}_corpus/*
    20	  fi
    21	done
    22
